parsed.name: Aim-TTI EL302P 单路直流电源
parsed.name_en: Aim-TTI EL302P Single-Output DC Power Supply
parsed.description: Aim-TTI EL302P 是一台单路可编程直流电源，可提供可调电压与电流并控制输出开关。它常用于电子电路供电、器件调试、台式测试以及一般实验室电源应用。
parsed.description_en: The Aim-TTI EL302P is a single-output programmable DC power supply that provides adjustable voltage and current with controllable output on/off. It is commonly used for powering electronic circuits, device debugging, bench testing, and general laboratory power applications.
